context.analysis:
## Overview
A unified cross-border telehealth SaaS platform providing video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. It enforces strict regional data residency and compliance using isolated cloud deployments.

## Key Elements
- **Patients & Licensed Clinicians:** Primary human users interacting via Web and Mobile Apps (HTTPS/WebRTC).
- **Pharmacies & Regional Health Authorities/Payers:** External systems handling prescriptions, claims, and reimbursement.
- **AI Triage Model Provider:** GCP Vertex AI managing symptom-checking inference.
- **Identity & Consent Providers:** Region-specific IAM systems supporting OIDC/SAML.
- **Cross-Border Telehealth Platform:** Core system deployed regionally in GCP (`europe-west3` and `us-central1`).

## Relationships
- Patients and Clinicians connect via WebRTC (video) and HTTPS (APIs).
- Core Platform integrates with Pharmacies and Payers using REST and HL7 FHIR protocols.
- Regional platforms communicate with GCP Vertex AI via version-pinned inference APIs.
- Systems enforce mTLS for inter-service and cross-region communication.

## Technology Stack
- **Cloud Provider (GCP):** Deployed in `europe-west3` and `us-central1` for geographical data isolation.
- **Data Privacy & Security:** GCP Cloud KMS (CMEK) and VPC Service Controls for GDPR/HIPAA compliance.
- **Resilience & Streaming:** GCP Media CDN with WebRTC SFU edge relays for low-bandwidth connections (<300 kbit/s).
- **Integration & Messaging:** GCP Pub/Sub for asynchronous regional payer integrations.
- **Audit & Observability:** GCP Cloud Logging with bucket-lock and OpenTelemetry for EU MDR traceability and tracing.

## Rationale
Dual-region GCP deployment guarantees strict regional data residency while supporting cross-border access via explicit patient consent tokens. Asynchronous messaging and edge media relays ensure high availability and performance even in unstable rural network conditions.

containers.analysis:
## Overview
[Cross-Border Telehealth Platform [softwareSystem, context]: A unified cross-border telehealth SaaS platform providing video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US, enforcing strict regional data residency and compliance using isolated cloud deployments.]

## Key Elements
• [Patients & Licensed Clinicians [person, context]]
• [Pharmacies & Regional Health Authorities/Payers [externalSystem, context]]
• [AI Triage Model Provider [externalSystem, context] (GCP Vertex AI)]
• [Identity & Consent Providers [externalSystem, context]]
• [Web & Mobile Apps [container, Flutter/React]]
• [API Gateway & BFF [container, Envoy/Go]]
• [Core Telehealth Service [container, Java/Spring Boot]]
• [AI Triage Service [container, Python/FastAPI]]
• [Consent & Audit Ledger [container, PostgreSQL]]
• [E-Prescription Dispatcher [container, Go]]

## Relationships
• [Patients & Licensed Clinicians -> Cross-Border Telehealth Platform (HTTPS/WebRTC)]
• [Cross-Border Telehealth Platform -> Pharmacies & Regional Health Authorities/Payers (REST / HL7 FHIR)]
• [Cross-Border Telehealth Platform -> AI Triage Model Provider (Version-pinned inference APIs (mTLS))]
• [Cross-Border Telehealth Platform -> Identity & Consent Providers (OIDC / SAML)]

## Technology Stack
• [Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Target cloud provider utilizing regions europe-west3 and us-central1 for strict regional data residency.]
• [Istio Service Mesh: Enforces mTLS and zero-trust traffic segmentation within regional clusters.]
• [PostgreSQL: Serves as the Consent & Audit Ledger, secured via Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) via Cloud KMS.]
• [Flutter/React: Technologies for building the client-facing Web & Mobile Apps.]
• [Envoy/Go: Powers the API Gateway & BFF container for external traffic routing and TLS termination.]
• [Java/Spring Boot: Implements the Core Telehealth Service business logic.]
• [Python/FastAPI: Powers the AI Triage Service for local PHI/PII sanitization and model interaction.]

## Rationale
[Regionally isolated container clusters in GCP ensure strict adherence to GDPR and HIPAA data residency constraints. Decoupled microservices with localized data storage and strict cryptographic controls maintain traceability, availability under low bandwidth, and secure cross-border compliance.]

Web & Mobile Apps.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides secure video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. It enforces strict regional data residency, HIPAA/GDPR compliance, and resilient access for rural users.

## Key Elements
- Patients & Licensed Clinicians
- Web & Mobile Apps (Flutter/React)
- API Gateway & BFF (Envoy/Go)
- Core Telehealth Service (Java/Spring Boot)
- AI Triage Service (Python/FastAPI)
- Consent & Audit Ledger (PostgreSQL)
- E-Prescription Dispatcher (Go)
- AI Triage Model Provider (GCP Vertex AI)
- Identity & Consent Providers

## Relationships
- Patients & Licensed Clinicians -> Web & Mobile Apps: HTTPS/WebRTC
- Web & Mobile Apps -> API Gateway & BFF: HTTPS with certificate pinning and short-lived JWTs
- API Gateway & BFF -> Core Telehealth Service: gRPC / REST
- API Gateway & BFF -> AI Triage Service: gRPC / REST
- Core Telehealth Service -> Consent & Audit Ledger: PostgreSQL Wire Protocol
- Core Telehealth Service -> E-Prescription Dispatcher: Internal Messaging / gRPC
- AI Triage Service -> AI Triage Model Provider: Version-pinned inference APIs (mTLS)
- E-Prescription Dispatcher -> Pharmacies & Regional Health Authorities/Payers: REST / HL7 FHIR

## Technology Stack
- Flutter/React: Cross-platform UI for resilient local-first client state and offline caching in rural areas.
- WebRTC: Low-bandwidth video consultations supporting degraded connections below 300 kbit/s.
- GCP Cloud CDN / Cloud Storage: Global static asset delivery isolated across `europe-west3` and `us-central1`.
- PostgreSQL: Structured data storage secured via Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) via Cloud KMS.
- GCP Vertex AI: Managed infrastructure for AI symptom-checker inference.

## Rationale
This architecture ensures strict regional data residency and compliance via isolated GCP region deployments while supporting low-bandwidth rural connectivity. Modular microservices and explicit client security controls protect sensitive health data across international borders.

API Gateway & BFF.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides secure video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker across the EU and US. It enforces regional data residency and compliance via isolated GCP deployments in `europe-west3` and `us-central1`.

## Key Elements
- Patients & Licensed Clinicians [person, context]
- Web & Mobile Apps [container] (Flutter/React)
- API Gateway & BFF [container] (Envoy/Go)
  - Edge Router & TLS Terminator [component] (Envoy Proxy)
  - Rate Limiting & Resilience Proxy [component] (Envoy/Go)
  - Patient & Clinician BFF Service [component] (Go)
  - Audit & Metadata Interceptor [component] (Go)
- Core Telehealth Service [container] (Java/Spring Boot)
- AI Triage Service [container] (Python/FastAPI)
- Consent & Audit Ledger [container] (PostgreSQL)
- E-Prescription Dispatcher [container] (Go)
- AI Triage Model Provider [externalSystem, context] (GCP Vertex AI)
- Identity & Consent Providers [externalSystem, context]

## Relationships
- Patients & Licensed Clinicians -> Web & Mobile Apps: Accesses telehealth features [HTTPS / WebRTC]
- Web & Mobile Apps -> API Gateway & BFF: Sends client requests [HTTPS]
- API Gateway & BFF -> Core Telehealth Service: Routes business logic requests [gRPC / mTLS]
- API Gateway & BFF -> AI Triage Service: Routes symptom-checker requests [gRPC / mTLS]
- Core Telehealth Service -> Consent & Audit Ledger: Persists audit logs and consent [PostgreSQL Wire Protocol]
- AI Triage Service -> AI Triage Model Provider: Requests symptom inference [Version-pinned inference APIs / mTLS]
- E-Prescription Dispatcher -> Pharmacies & Regional Health Authorities/Payers: Dispatches prescriptions [REST / HL7 FHIR]

## Technology Stack
- Envoy Proxy: Handles edge routing, TLS termination, WAF, and rate limiting.
- Go: Powers the BFF service, e-prescription dispatcher, and resilience proxies for high performance.
- Java / Spring Boot: Implements core telehealth business logic.
- Python / FastAPI: Powers local PHI/PII sanitization for the AI Triage Service.
- PostgreSQL: Stores consent and audit ledger data with CMEK encryption.
- GCP (`europe-west3`, `us-central1`): Enforces regional data residency and cloud infrastructure.

## Rationale
The architecture ensures GDPR and HIPAA compliance by enforcing strict regional data separation between the EU and US deployments. The BFF pattern and payload optimization maintain high availability and usability for rural patients on unstable connections below 300 kbit/s.

Isolating regional deployments in GCP (`europe-west3` and `us-central1`) strictly enforces GDPR and HIPAA data residency mandates. Decomposing the Consent & Audit Ledger with cryptographic integrity and dedicated reporting interfaces satisfies EU MDR traceability and audit requirements without exposing raw PHI.
